subject: Coverage triage — forecast stabilization & stage confirmations
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage triage + forecast stabilization (Q3 upsell)

Team —

Finance asked for a quick hygiene sweep across the expansion pipeline so the Q3 numbers are stable by EOD Monday. This is specifically about stage accuracy and confirmed next steps for deals in the +$100k band where CS is the primary owner of the upsell motion.

Ask: can CS confirm stage + next step for the three accounts below in the tracker (attached)? If stage moves to "Commit" please attach the stakeholder email that confirms budget or signature timeline. If still "Evaluation", add the blocking action and expected working owner.

Top accounts in scope (from motion tracker):
- Acme Corp — near-term SOW + procurement questions (contact: procurement@acme.com)
- Horizon Health — pilot extension decision pending (contact: emma@horizonhealth.com)
- Verde Labs — transactional review, pricing negotiation ongoing (not cc'd here — I'll loop if needed)

I've attached the Q3_upsell_motion_tracker.csv with current stages and last touch timestamps. Finance will use this to finalize the commit column in the forecast; we need conservative attribution if we don't have explicit commitment.

Timeline: please update by EOD Monday (2027-08-30 17:00 PT). If you need a 10-min sync, I can open a slot today at 4pm.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Attachment: Q3_upsell_motion_tracker.csv (csv, 48KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage triage + forecast stabilization (Q3 upsell)

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear asks. Quick notes from CS intake after a morning review of the tracker: 

- Acme Corp: We have verbal approval for scope but procurement still wants a redline on the SOW. Procurement indicated an internal approval window of ~2 weeks. I've attached the latest Acme_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf and flagged the clause they want changed (section 4.2 on data retention).

- Horizon Health: Pilot extension decision expected by Sep 7. The buyer has asked for a one-week extension for legal review. CS recommends marking this as "Likely but not Commit" — we don't have a signed PO yet.

- Verde Labs: Pricing conversation stalled while lead evaluates competing bids. CS will re-engage next week; recommend moving to "At Risk" for forecasting purposes.

Action items: 
1) Marcus — can you validate if Finance will accept "verbal approval + SOW redline in progress" as partial commit (50% weighted) for Acme? We need to standardize weighting for SOW-pending deals.
2) Neha — please add the procurement contact at Acme into the tracker and paste the most recent email thread for audit.
3) Irene — I'll update the tracker rows and add short notes under "commit rationale".

If anyone wants to jump on a 10-min call today at 16:00 PT to move Acme forward, I'm available.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Acme_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage triage + forecast stabilization (Q3 upsell)

Monica — thanks for the summaries. Short answer on weighting: Finance will accept a provisional commit at 60% for deals with documented verbal approval + SOW redline in progress, but only if:

- the procurement owner is named in the tracker with an email thread captured, and
- there is a clear signature timeline (procurement expects signature within 30 days).

For Acme specifically: if you can paste the procurement rep's email and an explicit timeline estimate in the tracker I will tag it as 60% commit for the planning workbook. If we don't have those items, it'll be recorded as 0% (pipeline) or 25% (if there's demonstrable legal review but no named procurement contact).

Also — let's be careful not to double-count Horizon's pilot in the committed column. Until we have a PO or signed SOW I'll categorize Horizon as 25% in the forecast workbook.

Irene — please confirm whether Finance prefers a single commit column or a split "commit / contingent" columns for the final workbook; my preference is split so we can reconcile audit trails later.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage triage + forecast stabilization (Q3 upsell)

Perfect — thanks all. Quick confirmations: 

- We'll adopt Marcus's provisional weighting (60% for verbal+SOW-in-progress with procurement contact + timeline).
- Finance asks for two columns in the workbook: "Commit (audited)" and "Contingent (weighted)". The auditing artifact (email/SOW) should be referenced in the tracker row.
- Monica: please update Acme row with procurement contact and paste the last procurement message. Also set a new CRM task to follow up with Horizon legal on Sep 2.

I'll open a 10-min meeting at 16:00 PT if anyone wants to join, otherwise we'll rely on the tracker updates by Monday EOD for finalization.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
